[LGRA.5.10] **Identity markers key on the base lifecycle; the
`ambient` modifier is transparent.** Every slot of a `logical`-based
schema — `scope logical` or `scope logical ambient` — must carry
exactly one of the `key` / `mutable` slot markers (require-all); the
compiler rejects a `logical`-based schema with an unmarked slot. `key`
/ `mutable` are barred on an `explicit` / `ttl` / `activation` base
(including `scope ttl <dur> ambient`); the compiler rejects either
marker there. The identity-key model these markers declare is
[LFAC.1.7]. A `ts` slot carries neither marker on any base: it is the
engine's ([LFAC.9.1]), and the compiler rejects a marker on it.
